# Flames Gourmet

> Specialty Indian restaurant in Canada. Authentic Indian spice, gourmet soul — premium Indian flavors crafted fresh for dine-in, take-away and à-la-carte ordering.

Flames Gourmet is an Indian restaurant offering signature curries, biryanis, dosas, sandwiches, snacks, sweets and packaged foods. Orders are placed online and paid in cash at the counter.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://flamesgourmet.ca/): Overview of the restaurant, featured dishes and promotions.
- [Menu](https://flamesgourmet.ca/menu): Full food menu organized by category.
- [Shop](https://flamesgourmet.ca/shop): Online ordering for pickup.
- [Promotions](https://flamesgourmet.ca/promotions): Current offers and coupons.
- [About](https://flamesgourmet.ca/about): Our story, sourcing and kitchen.
- [Contact](https://flamesgourmet.ca/contact): Address, hours and contact form.

## Legal

- [Legal & Policies](https://flamesgourmet.ca/legal): Privacy policy, terms and refund policy.
